## Recall: expand three expressions {#expansion-recall}

We are learning to factorise fully. I can choose a method, check for another factor and expand to verify my answer.

Close your notes. Allow about three minutes. Expand each expression on paper, then select **Next** to check one answer at a time.

| A | B | C |
|:--|:--|:--|
| $(3x-5)^2$ | $(3x-5)(3x+5)$ | $(3x-5)(x+5)$ |

::: {.fragment}

**A.** $(3x-5)^2=9x^2-15x-15x+25=9x^2-30x+25$

The brackets are identical. Both cross products are $-15x$.

:::

::: {.fragment}

**B.** $(3x-5)(3x+5)=9x^2+15x-15x-25=9x^2-25$

The cross products cancel. Read the equality backwards to see how to factorise $9x^2-25$.

:::

::: {.fragment}

**C.** $(3x-5)(x+5)=3x^2+15x-5x-25=3x^2+10x-25$

The first terms differ. The cross products add to $10x$.

:::
